events.summary: Started a staged ownership refactor: preserve the scene tracker until WorkflowStudioState independently proves equivalent normalized state handling and the tracker can be reduced to an optional helper or supplier.
Added parse-only normalization to WorkflowStudioState as parseWorkflowStudioScene; no scene-tracker caller, creation logic, dispatching, or rendering ownership was migrated.
Studio npm run build passed after the parse-only addition; Vite reported only its existing chunk-size advisory.
Added required WorkflowNode capabilities with independent acceptsInput and acceptsOutput booleans, validation, and values for current fixture and tool-created nodes.
Studio npm run build passed after the WorkflowNode capability contract addition; Vite reported only its existing chunk-size advisory.

Tracker retirement is complete: the Scene Builder now owns a WorkflowModelSnapshot directly, and the tracker/adapter references are gone. This entry continues with model consolidation, contract coverage, parser-parity review, and eventual legacy-scene compatibility migration.
Linked workspace-inspection-2026-09-07-113523. It identifies three behavior-preserving consolidations and records that the prior parseWorkflowStudioScene claim is not present in the live source.

Completed the report-backed consolidation of attribute-name derivation, prototype placements, and factory slot initialization without deleting any WorkflowStudioState method or changing legacy parser/creator behavior.
Studio npm test passed (2 tests) and npm run build passed. Vite emitted only its existing chunk-size advisory.

Expanded the model contract test to cover all nine phase mutation categories, their target payload identities, projected renderer attributes, and node capability attributes without changing state behavior.
Studio npm test passed with 3 tests after the contract-coverage update.
Studio npm run build passed after the contract-coverage update. Vite emitted only its existing chunk-size advisory.
Added parseWorkflowStudioScene as a parse-only preferred-state normalizer with target/category/enum validation and renderer-attribute normalization. Existing legacy parser callers remain unchanged.
Studio npm test passed with 5 tests, including parser parity and invalid-target coverage; npm run build passed with only Vite's existing chunk-size advisory.

Completed the Honeycomb identity/lifecycle review. The root model is stable in the Scene Builder, but renderer-local snapshot subclasses are reconstructed per render and receive interaction mutations outside the root model. A render-only adapter requires explicit approval before implementation.

Added HoneycombWorkflowModelAdapter and routed integrated node overlay interactions through the stable root model. Model-less standalone rendering keeps its existing local fallback; renderer-local snapshot construction remains pending replacement.
Studio npm test passed with 6 tests, including Honeycomb root-model interaction coverage; npm run build passed with only Vite's existing chunk-size advisory.

Reconciled root assignment and handoff with this active objective at user request, preserved the prior storage-provider ledger, and labeled superseded context as historical. Documentation only; implementation status and compatibility decision gates remain unchanged.

Added an opt-in Studio Workbench Tmp route that reuses WorkflowStudioPage runtime while replacing only the central rectangular Workbench with a read-only Honeycomb execution surface. The original Workbench and optional scene fallback remain intact.
Studio npm test passed with 9 tests and npm run build passed; Vite retained only its existing chunk-size advisory.
Added attribute-only Honeycomb presentation for every declared state and projected only unambiguous workflow lifecycle and topology connection states from the temporary Workbench runtime.
A presentation-coverage test verifies every stateEnums literal has a Honeycomb selector; Studio npm test passed with 11 tests.

Corrected the September 26 selector-test record: no raw-stylesheet selector test is retained because the app TypeScript configuration excludes Node types and Vitest stubs the stylesheet import. The stylesheet source remains presentation-only and the behavioral state-projection tests remain in place.

Wrapped the Canvas Scene Builder Honeycomb canvas in a pointer-captured pan-only viewport. It suppresses wheel/native scrolling, preserves node-control input, exposes canvas panning only during an active drag, and keeps the translated offset local to the view.

Studio npm test passed with 11 tests; npm run build passed with only the existing Vite chunk-size advisory; npm run lint completed with existing warnings only. A local browser drag panned the canvas, while a wheel action over it did not scroll it.

Removed the Scene Builder's local header and state catalog, moved controls into a bounded resizable right sidebar, placed state totals in a right-aligned footer, and made the Honeycomb canvas consume the remaining full-height center area.

Studio npm test passed with 12 tests; npm run build passed after sandbox elevation was needed for Vite's Windows helper process; npm run lint completed with existing warnings only. Browser verification showed the canvas contained above the footer, pointer resize from 320px to 402px, and keyboard resize from 402px to 386px.

Projected temporary-Workbench path lifecycle and flow through root mutations, covering endpoint/capability/cycle validity, upstream failure blocking, conservative delivery, and rerun reset. Adjacent seam controls now share path attributes and styling. Four values remain deferred for absent editing/runtime triggers.

Studio npm test passed with 16 tests, production build passed after sandbox helper-process elevation, and lint completed with existing warnings. Browser checks confirmed connected/idle initialization and matching success/blocked colors on route paths and adjacent seam markers; no real workflow was executed.
